title: Remove a workaround for the CUDA bug that cannot be reproduced
bug_description:
As in the title with reference to

https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/17ab99463a62d3bde2cdbdd420b62784d15e5eef/c10/core/ScalarType.h#L108-L115

I tried to reproduce the bug with CUDA versions down to 11.0.1 with no success.

@ezyang , do you remember what CUDA version was used that revealed to the bug? From the gh blame, I assume this was about 6 years ago.

cc @malfet @seemethere @ptrblck @msaroufim @eqy @jerryzh168
